issue.title: Externals lost after splitting code in AMD

repository.name: webpack
repository.description: A bundler for javascript and friends. Packs many modules into a few bundled assets. Code Splitting allows for loading parts of the application on demand. Through "loaders", modules can be CommonJs, AMD, ES6 modules, CSS, Images, JSON, Coffeescript, LESS, ... and your custom stuff.

issue.body:
1. I had an entry point with 2 deps (depA and depB), and external dependencies defined by a function with a regex (`libraryTarget: amd`). All resolved external modules were dependencies of my final bundle. 
2. I removed depA from the entry point array of dependencies and add my dependency it within a function with the `bundle-loader`. 
3. After building again, I lost all the external modules that were previously resolved presumably when parsing depA deps.

It's like Webpack doesn't analyze `require.ensure` deps during bundling. And as I use a regex to determine the `externals`, it's complicated to manually solve it.

Help?
Thanks
